description: Rust applications: rust-toolchain plus `rust-version` in every Cargo.toml, moved in the same `rust toolchain` pull request. Not for libraries: there `rust-version` is the MSRV, a compatibility promise raised by decision, not a pin to keep current.

customManagers.description: Renovate's cargo manager does not extract `rust-version`. Tracked as the `rust` Docker image so it shares docker versioning with the `rust:<version>` base images (a `major.minor` value stays `major.minor`, a `major.minor.patch` value stays `major.minor.patch`) and joins the `rust toolchain` group by depName. Matches literal values in `[package]` and `[workspace.package]`; `rust-version.workspace = true` holds no version and is left alone.

packageRules.description: `rust-version` is a bare version, not an image reference: there is no digest to pin.
